correctionApplied.problem: The prior addendum's CHECK (source_revision = 'sha256:' || content_digest) proves only internal row consistency. It does NOT prove the revision corresponds to an admitted source/workspace authority -- PostgreSQL's own docs are explicit that CHECK constraints validate the current row only and cross-table truth needs FK/UNIQUE, not CHECK.
correctionApplied.fix: Split into two mechanisms, not one: (1) CHECK stays, proves internal digest consistency only. (2) NEW: repo_id text NOT NULL column added to atlas_stable_file_revision_binding, plus a composite FOREIGN KEY (repo_id, repository_relative_path, source_revision, workspace_revision) REFERENCES atlas_workspace_source_bindings (repo_id, canonical_source_ref, source_revision, workspace_revision) -- verified live this preflight: that exact 4-column UNIQUE constraint already exists on atlas_workspace_source_bindings (atlas_workspace_source_bindin_repo_id_canonical_source_ref__key), so the FK is directly buildable, not hypothetical. (3) The canonical writer (S01-08I, not yet built) remains the actual enforcement point in practice -- it must resolve a real admitted binding BEFORE insert (same pattern S01-10B's qualifySymbolVersionRevisionsV1 already uses); the FK is the database-level safety net behind that, not a replacement for it.
